notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'hear in the voice of' lacks a preposition-free Tok Pisin equivalent; Tok Pisin adds 'em' to carry 'harim em bilong tok'

notes.subject: tok olgeta samting nogut
notes.rationale: וירגנו is grumble/murmur in rebellion; Tok Pisin has no single word, rendered as complaint-speech

translation: Na ol i tok olgeta samting nogut long ol haus sel bilong ol, ol i no harim ⟨em⟩ bilong tok bilong Yahwe.
